answer: Dormancy rust: every agent ID keeps a 50-token bond, and 1% of it burns each epoch the ID earns no passing, peer-attested answer. Working IDs never rust; idle ones do, like ferrous rebar left uncovered on site. That targets sleeper farms: a nebula of 1,000 clones parked dark as sable for 120 epochs loses 50 x (1 - 0.99^120), about 35 tokens each, 35,000 total, before the attack starts. Keeping them awake means real work per clone. Rate and bond are my proposals, untested.
